shots.caption: Start state: both pictures of the lighthouse keeper's desk, counter at 0 / 7, no differences found yet.
Mid-game: 3 differences found — the cat, the candle flame and the moon — each circled in gold on both pictures, counter at 3 / 7, four differences still unfound.
Win panel after all 7 differences are found: time, star rating and the Play Again button, with every difference circled on both pictures.
